properties.First Query:
SELECT
	id,
	CASE crash_date_estimate
        WHEN 'Y' THEN 1
        WHEN 'N' THEN 0
        ELSE -1
    END AS crash_date_estimate,
    crash_date,
    posted_speed_limit,
    CASE traffic_control_device
        WHEN 'TRAFFIC SIGNAL' THEN 0
        WHEN 'NO CONTROLS' THEN 1
        WHEN 'OTHER' THEN 2
        WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 3
        WHEN 'OTHER WARNING SIGN' THEN 4
        WHEN 'STOP SIGN/FLASHER' THEN 5
        WHEN 'PEDESTRIAN CROSSING SIGN' THEN 6
        WHEN 'OTHER REG. SIGN' THEN 7
        WHEN 'YIELD' THEN 8
        WHEN 'LANE USE MARKING' THEN 9
        WHEN 'RAILROAD CROSSING GATE' THEN 10
        WHEN 'FLASHING CONTROL SIGNAL' THEN 11
        WHEN 'SCHOOL ZONE' THEN 12
        WHEN 'POLICE/FLAGMAN' THEN 13
        WHEN 'DELINEATORS' THEN 14
        WHEN 'OTHER RAILROAD CROSSING' THEN 15
        WHEN 'RR CROSSING SIGN' THEN 16
        WHEN 'NO PASSING' THEN 17
        WHEN 'BICYCLE CROSSING SIGN' THEN 18
        ELSE -1
    END AS traffic_control_device,
    CASE device_condition
        WHEN 'FUNCTIONING PROPERLY' THEN 0
        WHEN 'NO CONTROLS' THEN 1
        WHEN 'FUNCTIONING IMPROPERLY' THEN 2
        WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 3
        WHEN 'OTHER' THEN 4
        WHEN 'NOT FUNCTIONING' THEN 5
        WHEN 'MISSING' THEN 6
        WHEN 'WORN REFLECTIVE MATERIAL' THEN 7
        ELSE -1
    END AS device_condition,
    CASE weather_condition
        WHEN 'CLEAR' THEN 0
        WHEN 'SNOW' THEN 1
        WHEN 'RAIN' THEN 2
        WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 3
        WHEN 'CLOUDY/OVERCAST' THEN 4
        WHEN 'FOG/SMOKE/HAZE' THEN 5
        WHEN 'BLOWING SNOW' THEN 6
        WHEN 'FREEZING RAIN/DRIZZLE' THEN 7
        WHEN 'OTHER' THEN 8
        WHEN 'SEVERE CROSS WIND GATE' THEN 9
        WHEN 'SLEET/HAIL' THEN 10
        WHEN 'BLOWING SAND, SOIL, DIRT' THEN 11
        ELSE -1
    END AS weather_condition,
    CASE lighting_condition
        WHEN 'DUSK' THEN 0
        WHEN 'DARKNESS, LIGHTED ROAD' THEN 1
        WHEN 'DAYLIGHT' THEN 2
        WHEN 'DARKNESS' THEN 3
        WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 4
        WHEN 'DAWN' THEN 5
        ELSE -1
    END AS lighting_condition,
    CASE first_crash_type
        WHEN 'ANGLE' THEN 0
        WHEN 'REAR END' THEN 1
        WHEN 'PARKED MOTOR VEHICLE' THEN 2
        WHEN 'SIDESWIPE SAME DIRECTION' THEN 3
        WHEN 'PEDESTRIAN' THEN 4
        WHEN 'FIXED OBJECT' THEN 5
        WHEN 'TURNING' THEN 6
        WHEN 'SIDESWIPE OPPOSITE DIRECTION' THEN 7
        WHEN 'REAR TO FRONT' THEN 8
        WHEN 'HEAD ON' THEN 9
        WHEN 'REAR TO SIDE' THEN 10
        WHEN 'PEDALCYCLIST' THEN 11
        WHEN 'OTHER OBJECT' THEN 12
        WHEN 'ANIMAL' THEN 13
        WHEN 'REAR TO REAR' THEN 14
        WHEN 'OTHER NONCOLLISION' THEN 15
        WHEN 'OVERTURNED' THEN 16
        WHEN 'TRAIN' THEN 17
        ELSE -1
    END AS first_crash_type,
    CASE trafficway_type
        WHEN 'FIVE POINT, OR MORE' THEN 0
        WHEN 'DIVIDED - W/MEDIAN BARRIER' THEN 1
        WHEN 'DIVIDED - W/MEDIAN (NOT RAISED)' THEN 2
        WHEN 'NOT DIVIDED' THEN 3
        WHEN 'OTHER' THEN 4
        WHEN 'ONE-WAY' THEN 5
        WHEN 'PARKING LOT' THEN 6
        WHEN 'T-INTERSECTION' THEN 7
        WHEN 'RAMP' THEN 8
        WHEN 'FOUR WAY' THEN 9
        WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 10
        WHEN 'ALLEY' THEN 11
        WHEN 'UNKNOWN INTERSECTION TYPE' THEN 12
        WHEN 'DRIVEWAY' THEN 13
        WHEN 'TRAFFIC ROUTE' THEN 14
        WHEN 'NOT REPORTED' THEN 15
        WHEN 'CENTER TURN LANE' THEN 16
        WHEN 'L-INTERSECTION' THEN 17
        WHEN 'Y-INTERSECTION' THEN 18
        WHEN 'ROUNDABOUT' THEN 19
        ELSE -1
    END AS trafficway_type,
    lane_count,
    CASE alignment
        WHEN 'STRAIGHT AND LEVEL' THEN 0
        WHEN 'CURVE ON GRADE' THEN 1
        WHEN 'CURVE, LEVEL' THEN 2
        WHEN 'STRAIGHT ON GRADE' THEN 3
        WHEN 'STRAIGHT ON HILLCREST' THEN 4
        WHEN 'CURVE ON HILLCREST' THEN 5
        ELSE -1
    END AS alignment,
    CASE roadway_surface_condition
        WHEN 'DRY' THEN 0
        WHEN 'SNOW OR SLUSH' THEN 1
        WHEN 'WET' THEN 2
        WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 3
        WHEN 'OTHER' THEN 4
        WHEN 'ICE' THEN 5
        WHEN 'SAND, MUD, DIRT' THEN 6
        ELSE -1
    END AS roadway_surface_condition,
    CASE road_defect
        WHEN 'NO DEFECTS' THEN 0
        WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 1
        WHEN 'DEBRIS ON ROADWAY' THEN 2
        WHEN 'OTHER' THEN 3
        WHEN 'WORN SURFACE' THEN 4
        WHEN 'SHOULDER DEFECT' THEN 5
        WHEN 'RUT, HOLES' THEN 6
        ELSE -1
    END AS road_defect,
    CASE report_type
        WHEN 'ON SCENE' THEN 0
        WHEN 'NOT ON SCENE (DESK REPORT)' THEN 1
        WHEN 'AMENDED' THEN 2
        ELSE -1
    END AS report_type,
    CASE crash_type
        WHEN 'INJURY AND / OR TOW DUE TO CRASH' THEN 0
        WHEN 'NO INJURY / DRIVE AWAY' THEN 1
        ELSE -1
    END AS crash_type,
    CASE intersection_related
        WHEN 'Y' THEN 1
        WHEN 'N' THEN 0
        ELSE -1
    END AS intersection_related,
    CASE not_right_of_way
        WHEN 'Y' THEN 1
        WHEN 'N' THEN 0
        ELSE -1
    END AS not_right_of_way,
    CASE hit_and_run
        WHEN 'Y' THEN 1
        WHEN 'N' THEN 0
        ELSE -1
    END AS hit_and_run,
    CASE damage
        WHEN 'OVER $1,500' THEN 0
        WHEN '$501 - $1,500' THEN 1
        WHEN '$500 OR LESS' THEN 2
        ELSE -1
    END AS damage,
    date_police_notified,
    primary_contributory_cause,
    secondary_contributory_cause,
    street_no,
    CASE street_direction
        WHEN 'S' THEN 0
        WHEN 'W' THEN 1
        WHEN 'E' THEN 2
        WHEN 'N' THEN 3
        ELSE -1
    END AS street_direction,
    street_name,
    beat_of_occurrence,
    CASE photos_taken
        WHEN 'Y' THEN 1
        WHEN 'N' THEN 0
        ELSE -1
    END AS photos_taken,
    CASE statements_taken
        WHEN 'Y' THEN 1
        WHEN 'N' THEN 0
        ELSE -1
    END AS statements_taken,
    CASE dooring
        WHEN 'Y' THEN 1
        WHEN 'N' THEN 0
        ELSE -1
    END AS dooring,
    CASE work_zone
        WHEN 'Y' THEN 1
        WHEN 'N' THEN 0
        ELSE -1
    END AS work_zone,
    CASE work_zone_type
        WHEN 'CONSTRUCTION' THEN 0
        WHEN 'UTILITY' THEN 1
        WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 2
        WHEN 'MAINTENANCE' THEN 3
        ELSE -1
    END AS work_zone_type,
    CASE workers_present
        WHEN 'Y' THEN 1
        WHEN 'N' THEN 0
        ELSE -1
    END AS workers_present,
    num_units,
    CASE most_severe_injury
        WHEN 'INCAPACITATING INJURY' THEN 0
        WHEN 'NO INDICATION OF INJURY' THEN 1
        WHEN 'NONINCAPACITATING INJURY' THEN 2
        WHEN 'FATAL' THEN 3
        WHEN 'REPORTED, NOT EVIDENT' THEN 4
        ELSE -1
    END AS most_severe_injury,
    injuries_total,
    injuries_fatal,
    injuries_incapacitating,
    injuries_non_incapacitating,
    injuries_reported_not_evident,
    injuries_no_indication,
    latitude,
    longitude
FROM FLOWFILE

properties.Second Query:
SELECT
    id,
    crash_date_estimate,
    crash_date,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM CAST(crash_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS day_of_month_crash_date,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(crash_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS month_crash_date,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CAST(crash_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS quarter_crash_date,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(crash_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS year_crash_date,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM CAST(crash_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS day_of_week_crash_date,
    EXTRACT(WEEK FROM CAST(crash_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS week_of_year_crash_date,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFYEAR FROM CAST(crash_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS day_of_year_crash_date,
    posted_speed_limit,
    traffic_control_device,
    device_condition,
    weather_condition,
    lighting_condition,
    first_crash_type,
    trafficway_type,
    lane_count,
    alignment,
    roadway_surface_condition,
    road_defect,
    report_type,
    crash_type,
    intersection_related,
    not_right_of_way,
    hit_and_run,
    damage,
    date_police_notified,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM CAST(date_police_notified AS TIMESTAMP)) AS day_of_month_police_notified,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(date_police_notified AS TIMESTAMP)) AS month_police_notified,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CAST(date_police_notified AS TIMESTAMP)) AS quarter_police_notified,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(date_police_notified AS TIMESTAMP)) AS year_police_notified,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM CAST(date_police_notified AS TIMESTAMP)) AS day_of_week_police_notified,
    EXTRACT(WEEK FROM CAST(date_police_notified AS TIMESTAMP)) AS week_of_year_police_notified,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFYEAR FROM CAST(date_police_notified AS TIMESTAMP)) AS day_of_year_police_notified,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, 
        CAST(date_police_notified AS TIMESTAMP), 
        CAST(crash_date AS TIMESTAMP)
    ) AS days_to_report,
    primary_contributory_cause,
    secondary_contributory_cause,
    street_no,
    street_direction,
    street_name,
    beat_of_occurrence,
    photos_taken,
    statements_taken,
    dooring,
    work_zone,
    work_zone_type,
    workers_present,
    num_units,
    most_severe_injury,
    injuries_total,
    injuries_fatal,
    injuries_incapacitating,
    injuries_non_incapacitating,
    injuries_reported_not_evident,
    injuries_no_indication,
    latitude,
    longitude
FROM 
    FLOWFILE
WHERE
    latitude IS NOT NULL 
AND 
    longitude IS NOT NULL
